structured_output.explanation: Both monetary columns lost sub-unit precision. They still format to 2 decimals, but zero_fraction_rate jumped from ~0.01 to 1.0 for both columns, meaning every value now ends in .00. Samples confirm it: yesterday unit_price had values like 260.04/645.21/895.81 and amount like 1300.20/5806.89; today all are whole numbers (352.00, 261.00; 2113.00, 783.00). min/max collapsed to round values (unit_price 12.08→10.0, 899.36→899.0; amount 35.28→10.0, 7880.94→7875.0) and distinct counts dropped from rounding collisions (200→181 and 200→198). Values were rounded/truncated to whole currency units upstream, which silently biases revenue, margin, tax, and reconciliation analytics while the file still loads and parses fine. All other columns (schema, status vocabulary, date format, quantity, discount_pct, email nulls, duplicates) are unchanged; the order_id range shift is normal.
